app.name: AV wall panel controls
app.summary: Media keys for a wall panel: transport, D-pad, volume or channels, a number pad and a grid of inputs or activities.
app.transport_tile_example: Skip back, stop, play, pause, skip forward and eject
app.transport_key_previous_hint: The action of this key, such as media_player.media_previous_track. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.transport_key_stop_hint: Such as media_player.media_stop. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.transport_key_play_hint: Such as media_player.media_play. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.transport_key_pause_hint: Such as media_player.media_pause. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.transport_key_play_pause_hint: Such as media_player.media_play_pause. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.transport_key_next_hint: Such as media_player.media_next_track. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.transport_key_eject_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=EJECT, or script.turn_on script.eject_disc to act on another entity. Leave it empty to leave the key out. Until Tessera's icons have eject, the key shows the word.
app.dpad_tile_example: Arrow keys round an OK key, with back, home, menu and guide in the corners
app.dpad_key_back_hint: The action of this key, such as remote.send_command command=BACK. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.dpad_key_up_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=UP. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.dpad_key_home_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=HOME. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.dpad_key_left_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=LEFT. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.dpad_key_ok_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=OK. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.dpad_key_right_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=RIGHT. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.dpad_key_menu_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=MENU, or script.turn_on script.open_menu to act on another entity. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.dpad_key_down_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=DOWN. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.dpad_key_guide_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=GUIDE. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.volume_tile_example: Quieter, mute and louder, or channel down and up, across a wide tile or down a tall one
app.volume_key_down_hint: The action of this key, such as media_player.volume_down (volume) or webostv.button button=CHANNELDOWN (channel). Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.volume_key_mute_hint: Volume style only; the channel style leaves it out. Such as remote.send_command command=MUTE, or media_player.volume_mute is_volume_muted=true. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.volume_key_up_hint: The action of this key, such as media_player.volume_up (volume) or webostv.button button=CHANNELUP (channel). Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.volume_style_hint: Volume shows quieter, mute and louder. Channel shows two chevron keys, channel down and up, and leaves the mute key out.
app.numpad_tile_example: Keys 0 to 9 with Clear and Enter, for a channel, a TV or a camera
app.numpad_action_hint: What a digit sends, with {digit} for the key pressed and {code} for the number so far, such as remote.send_command command=NUM_{digit} or input_number.set_value value={code}.
app.numpad_send_hint: Each digit sends the action as soon as its key is tapped. On Enter gathers the digits, shows them, and sends the whole number when Enter is tapped.
app.numpad_enter_hint: Show an Enter key. On Enter, it sends the number; with each digit, it needs its own action below.
app.numpad_enter_action_hint: What the Enter key sends instead, such as remote.send_command command=ENTER. Empty: on Enter, the action above with the number.
app.numpad_clear_hint: Show a Clear key that empties the number typed so far.
app.numpad_max_hint: How many digits the number holds. On Enter, further digits are refused; with each digit, the next one starts a new number.
app.numpad_idle_hint: Seconds without a tap after which the digits typed so far are forgotten. 0 keeps them until Clear or Enter.
app.numpad_show_hint: On Enter, show the digits typed so far above the keys. Turn it off to give the keys more room.
app.grid_tile_example: The options of a selector, a media player's inputs or a remote's activities, as a grid of keys
app.grid_hide_hint: Options not to show, written as the selector writes them (such as Off). Leave it empty to show them all.
